newsitem.title: USA: Nevada Power files to raise gas, power rates.
newsitem.headline: Nevada Power files to raise gas, power rates.

text.p: Nevada Power Co said Tuesday it filed with the Public Service Commission of Nevada (PSCN) to recover increased costs of natural gas and purchased power seen over the last twelve months.
The utility said the total change in rates necessary to relfect the higher market prices amounts to $54 million.
Approximately $40 million will affect commercial customers, while residential rates would increase by around $14 million, Nevada Power said.

"Since February 1997, our customers have seen credits on their monthly bills that reflected the low costs Nevada Power paid for natural gas and purchased power during 1996," said Cindy Gilliam, vice president of retail customer services.

"During the last few months, however, natural gas and purchased power prices have increased by as much as fifty percent. The adjustments requested in this filing will stop the refunding process and allow recovery of today's increased costs of producing and purchasing electricity. This case will have no effect on the profits of Nevada Power Company."
